rise.title: Peak energy in {{hours}}h
rise.body: Testosterone climbing. Save hard tasks for your window.

peak.title: Focus window open
peak.body: Best 90 minutes of your day. Hard decisions, deep work, tough calls — now.

dip.title: Cortisol dipping
dip.body: Irritability likely next 90 min. Avoid tough conversations. Walk, hydrate, breathe.

recovery.title: Wind-down window
recovery.body: Quality sleep tonight = testosterone tomorrow. Screens off by bed.

low_day_of_week.title: Heads up — {{dayName}}s run low
low_day_of_week.body: Your {{dayName}}s average below baseline. Schedule light, no critical meetings before 10am.

poor_sleep.title: Focus hit incoming
poor_sleep.body: You slept {{quality}}/10. Expect ~25% focus drop this afternoon. Delegate complex tasks.

high_stress_3d.title: Stress compounding
high_stress_3d.body: High stress 3 days running. 5 min of box breathing now beats 30 min tonight.

no_training_3d.title: Move your body
no_training_3d.body: 3 days without training. Your score drops measurably by day 4. 20 min minimum today.

improving_trend.title: You're on a roll
improving_trend.body: Score rising {{days}} days straight. Don't break the momentum — log tonight.

day_7_libido.title: Day {{days}} — libido peak
day_7_libido.body: Dopamine sensitivity climbing. Channel it into training or work, not noise.

day_9_fog.title: Day {{days}} — mental fog phase
day_9_fog.body: Typical j7-j10: decisions feel harder than they are. Be patient, defer big calls 48h.

day_14_focus.title: Day {{days}} — focus peak
day_14_focus.body: You're in the clearest window of your cycle. Ship the project you've been dodging.

milestone.title: {{days}} days strong
milestone.body: New streak PR. Check your stats — you'll see the pattern.

active.title: {{days}}-day streak
active.body: You've logged {{days}} days in a row. Don't break it — 60 seconds tonight.

broken.title: Restart your streak
broken.body: You missed yesterday. Quick log to rebuild — patterns reveal faster than you think.

daily_reminder.title: Daily check-in
daily_reminder.body: 60 seconds to log your day. Your future self thanks you.
